notes.title: v 1.6.3
notes.content:
Introduced the option to receive multiple rewards simultaneously in the mini-game 
 Resolved minor bugs

notes.title: v 1.6.2
notes.content:
Updated coin exchange rate
 Fixed issue when default coin was assigned unexpectedly after exchange
 Small UI updates
 Updated reward preview UI
 Optimized game assets

notes.title: v 1.6.0
notes.content:
Reduced game size. Compressed audio files that were taking a lot of space.
 Added 4 new music tracks.
 Added additional save file backups. The game now creates backup saves every 5 minutes. If your main save gets damaged or lost, the system will load the latest working backup.
 Updated save file system. This resolves issues where saves couldn't be loaded on other PCs. However, you still need to run the game once on the original device to auto-migrate your save to the new format.
 Small UI bug fixes.
 Increased daily task rewards.
 Added ability to buy tickets in bulk based on how many points you have.
 Added sorting by skin quantity in the inventory menu.
 Updated spin mini-game UI.
 Added coin exchange system in inventory menu. You can now exchange Common, Uncommon, and Rare coins for Epic coins. Epic coins can be exchanged for Legendary.

notes.title: v 1.5.3
notes.content:
Fixed glitches on store page
 Fixed hotkeys in spin rewards page

notes.title: v 1.5.2
notes.content:
Small bug fixes.
 Added a label near the drop timer that shows which skin is currently locked in for the next reward. The drop system now clearly indicates which skin's rewards will be used when the drop occurs.
 Fixed some localization issues.
 Updated Steam Inventory playtime rules. You can now receive one unique skin every 15 minutes, up to 4 skins per hour.
 Added sorting dropdown to the in-game inventory for easier item browsing.

notes.title: v 1.5.1
notes.content:
Fixed rarity issues for some skins
 Updated localization

notes.title: v 1.5.0
notes.content:
Each coin skin now displays its rarity tier visually
 Minor fixes and improvements across supported languages
 Duplicate Skin Bonuses. Owning more than one copy of a coin skin now provides additional rewards
Manual and auto-click income gain a +0.5 multiplier bonus per duplicate
Ticket drops gain +1 ticket multiplier per duplicate
Example: If you own 3 copies of a skin that normally gives 10 per click and 4 tickets per drop:
Manual Click: 10 + (10 × 0.5 × 2) = 20
Tickets per Drop: 4 × 2 = 8
 Addressed various minor issues for improved stability
 All coin skins now drop at least 1 hour sooner than before
 Following player feedback, the anti-cheat system has been removed
 Added support for Esc and Enter keys to close or confirm modal windows
 You can now click the coin using the Spacebar
 A visual preview now appears when a new reward is granted
 Toggle the auto-clicker from the main screen or by pressing F2
 Rewards from daily tasks have been significantly increased
 Fixed Steam inventory integration

notes.title: v 1.4.0
notes.content:
- Added coin bounce effect when auto-clicker is enabled
- Manual clicks now can register both left and right mouse buttons
- Updated anti-cheat thresholds
- Fixed game freeze issue while changing song
- Fixed the tickets count in shop menu

notes.title: Patch 2 - Removed steam inventory dependency
notes.content:
- In this version I removed steam inventory dependency as it was causing issues for in-game inventory
- Added a small bonus in points, tickets and skins for the inconvenience
